name: @repttyl/desktop
description: Desktop app for Repttyl remote terminal workspaces

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @repttyl/client-node build && pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.start:vnc: pnpm run build && DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:99} ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 REPTTYL_VNC=1 electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.start:vnc:devtools: pnpm run build && DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:99} ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 REPTTYL_VNC=1 REPTTYL_OPEN_DEVTOOLS=1 electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.make: pnpm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --publish never
